description.p: Sukut removes music from what your computer plays, while keeping speech and other sounds. Everything is processed on your computer.
يزيل سُكوت الموسيقى مما يشغّله حاسوبك مع إبقاء الكلام والأصوات الأخرى. تجري المعالجة كلها على حاسوبك.

description.p: New hand app icon, the original Seen in the tray, and Android polish: a clearer Debugging tile and corrected Arabic.
Stable Linux release with refreshed branding, a lighter tray and polished Android activation.
The first Flatpak build. On phones that USB can't reach from the sandbox, the Phone page points to Wireless debugging.
New headphones are used as soon as they connect, a missing output no longer stops Start, and Sukut stops audio loops with EasyEffects.
The first Linux build: the GNOME window, the tray, PipeWire audio and the phone tools.
